question: What act of sprinkling should the meditator recollect upon the visualized figure?
premises: The sprinkling is done by all with milk-water.
The practitioner is instructed to recollect this.
inference: The meditator should recollect the figure being sprinkled on all sides with milk-water.
uncertainties: The token kṣīrodavi(śe appears incomplete or irregular in the source.
plain_english: One should recollect the figure being sprinkled on all sides with milk-water.
